root: ^It's so nice to finally meet you!
^...Though I guess Mote will be talking more to the player today.
^I'm Mote! I'm one of the Mortems you'll be managing in this playtest!
^Your job as the manager is to oversee the Mortems in your facility, and try to research them to their fullest.
^You've got a few employees to start, and they'll be the ones you'll send out to perform the research.
^Let's take a look at what one might look like!
^That top number is his BODY. It's how many hits he's taken, and how many more he can take. Pretty simple!
^Below that is his MIND. It starts high, but various Mortems and effects can lower it.
^If it gets too low, some seriously bad things can happen!
^Next to that is their DISBELIEF. The better it is, the more it takes for an employee's MIND to decrease.
^As we can see, Mark's DISBELIEF is... not great.
^...Anyways! Last of all is their HEART!
^HEART indicates how an employee feels towards Mortems as a whole.
^Higher means they view them positively, and lower means they view us... pretty fairly, all things considered.
^Most Mortems aren't nearly as nice as Mote...
^You don't always want an employee to have a lot of HEART. Sometimes its better if an employee can distance themselves!
^That's pretty much all there is to employees!
^During the day, you'll have the choice of where to send each employee.
^You can either assign them to a Mortem or send them to one of the training units.
^When dealing with a Mortem, it'll be up to you to guide your employee through the process!
^There are some Mortems where one wrong step can be disastrous, so your employees are putting their trust into you!
^If you're worried about a certain employee, you can always choose to send them to training instead.
^Good luck Augustus! Mote believes in you!
